issues.title: Expected permission no longer granted

evidence.message: Page admin role downgraded; pages_manage_posts no longer granted | missing permission(s): pages_manage_posts
Page admin role downgraded; pages_manage_posts no longer granted | missing permission(s): pages_manage_posts

issues.likely_cause: A scope was revoked or the connecting user's role on the asset was downgraded.
issues.recommended_action: Restore the role/scope on the platform side, then reconnect in Spikerz so the missing permission is re-granted.

corrective_actions.detail: Confirmed pages_manage_posts missing from granted scopes. Raised with Page owner to restore the admin role.
Admin role restored on Mock QA Page B and account reconnected so pages_manage_posts is re-granted. Expect clear on next check.

issues.title: Access token expired

evidence.message: 401 invalid_token: access token expired and refresh token was not rotated

issues.likely_cause: Access token reached end of life and was not refreshed (refresh token missing, rotated, or expired).
issues.recommended_action: Re-authorise the account to mint a new token; check why the scheduled refresh did not run.

corrective_actions.detail: Token expired. Re-authorised the account to mint a new access token; opened follow-up to find out why refresh did not run.

issues.title: Account restricted by platform

evidence.message: Account flagged by platform integrity checks; API returns account_restricted
Account flagged by platform integrity checks; API returns account_restricted
Account flagged by platform integrity checks; API returns account_restricted

issues.likely_cause: Platform integrity checks flagged the account (unusual login pattern, new-account activity limits, or automation signals).
issues.recommended_action: Pause tests using this account, complete any platform verification prompts manually, and swap in a standby account if the restriction lasts more than 48h.

corrective_actions.detail: Account restricted by platform. Paused all tests that use TT-002; will re-check for 48h before replacing.
Restriction has now lasted 3 checks (>48h). Proposed retirement via `account retire TT-002` and requested a standby TikTok test account.

issues.title: Account disconnected from Spikerz

evidence.message: Session invalidated after a password change on the linked account

issues.likely_cause: The platform session/grant was invalidated (password change, user revoked the app, or forced logout).
issues.recommended_action: Reconnect the account through the Spikerz UI connection flow and re-run the health check.

corrective_actions.detail: Reconnected through the connection workflow after the session was invalidated by a password change [evidence: docs/connection-workflow.md]

issues.title: Expected connected asset is missing

evidence.message: Page no longer returned by /me/accounts for the connected user | missing asset(s): page:Mock QA Page A

issues.likely_cause: The asset (page / handle) was unlinked, unpublished, or the connected user lost access to it.
issues.recommended_action: Confirm the asset still exists and the connected user still has access, then re-select it in Spikerz.

corrective_actions.detail: Mock QA Page A no longer returned for the connected user. Investigating whether the Page was unlinked or the user lost access; issue left open.
